Onchain Analytics for Stellar

SCF #46
$150.0K
Build
Submitted

Products & Services

Starting point: what SCF #38 delivered

  • Dedicated Stellar indexing layer, built and maintained in BigQuery, fed daily from Stellar Core and Horizon

  • Standardized network KPIs and dashboards for ecosystem projects

  • 58 Stellar ecosystem projects listed on Token Terminal

  • 47 Stellar-issued tokenized assets tracked, $4B+ in onchain market cap (as of 3 November 2026)

This submission: complete coverage of Stellar's tokenized asset and RWA ecosystem, with asset details verified directly with issuers, so institutions can evaluate Stellar assets with the same rigor as traditional securities.

1. Stellar tokenized asset registry and review process

  • What: a continuously updated registry of every tokenized asset issued on Stellar, covering classic Stellar assets and Soroban token contracts, classified by type (stablecoin, tokenized fund, treasury, private credit, tokenized stock, etc.) and reference asset, with ongoing review of newly deployed assets

  • Stellar usage: asset issuance, trustlines and Soroban contract events read directly from our Stellar pipeline

  • Impact: new issuers on Stellar get listed and benchmarked quickly, instead of waiting for manual coverage

2. Standardized tokenized asset metrics for Stellar

  • What: onchain market cap, supply, holders, transfer volume, mints and redemptions, and issuer-level aggregates for every covered Stellar asset

  • Stellar usage: calculated from Stellar onchain data with the same methodology we use across 14,400+ tokenized assets on other chains

  • Impact: Stellar assets become directly comparable with the same products on Ethereum, Solana and other networks

3. Fact Sheets for Stellar assets

  • What: structured, issuer-verified Fact Sheets for every Stellar tokenized asset with meaningful onchain traction and reliable price feeds: issuer, custodian, transfer agent, domicile, legal structure, rights, fees and onchain metrics in one standardized view

  • Stellar usage: Stellar onchain data combined with issuer-provided offchain data, verified directly with asset issuers

  • Impact: gives asset managers, banks and allocators the due-diligence view they need to hold or integrate Stellar-issued assets

4. Full coverage on the Tokenized Assets and RWA sector pages

  • What: Stellar and its issuers featured across Token Terminal's Tokenized Assets page and RWA market sector

  • Stellar usage: Stellar available as a filter in every cross-chain comparison

  • Impact: Stellar's share of the tokenized asset market becomes visible wherever institutions compare chains

5. Data distribution to partner platforms

  • What: Stellar network, ecosystem and tokenized asset data delivered through our API, Google Sheets and Excel plugin, MCP connector and data catalog (BigQuery)

  • Stellar usage: included in the data we deliver to redistribution partners: Binance, CoinGecko, CoinMarketCap, The Block, Robinhood and FactSet

  • Impact: Stellar metrics reach the terminals, exchanges, AI agents and research tools where investors already work

6. Daily indexing, contract labeling and maintenance

  • What: daily runs of the Stellar indexing layer in BigQuery, plus continuous labeling of trending Stellar and Soroban contracts

  • Stellar usage: covers network KPIs (fees, revenue, active addresses, transactions, stablecoin supply), the 58 ecosystem project pages, protocol upgrades and data QA

  • Impact: Stellar data stays current and accurate, with coverage across all builders on Stellar, not only the largest projects; the foundation the tokenized asset work above is built on

7. Free public access: a public good for the Stellar ecosystem

  • What: every Stellar metric and data point delivered under this award is free to access in the Token Terminal UI, with no paywall

  • Stellar usage: our free MCP connector lets anyone query Stellar data directly from AI assistants and agents at no cost

  • Impact: standardized, institutional-grade Stellar data openly available to everyone, which no other data provider offers in this way

Tranche 1 (Deliverable Roadmap) - MVP

Tranche #1: Stellar data audit and tokenized asset registry

1.1 Stellar pipeline and KPI audit

  • Scope: review everything delivered in SCF #38 (the Stellar indexing layer in BigQuery, network KPIs and the 58 ecosystem project pages), resolve data issues and confirm compatibility with recent protocol and Soroban upgrades

  • How to measure completion: audit log of checks and fixes shared with SDF; all network KPIs and project pages pass QA

  • Budget: $15,000

1.2 Stellar tokenized asset registry

  • Scope: build a registry of every tokenized asset issued on Stellar, covering classic assets and Soroban token contracts, classified by asset type, reference asset and issuer

  • How to measure completion: registry live in our data warehouse, covering the 47 assets tracked today plus all newly identified Stellar assets

  • Budget: $20,000

1.3 Coverage review shared with SDF

  • Scope: a written review of Stellar's tokenized asset landscape and our coverage: gaps, data quality issues and a prioritized list of issuers for Fact Sheets

  • How to measure completion: review delivered to the SDF team and walked through on a call

  • Budget: $10,000

Tranche #1 total: $45,000

Tranche 2 (Deliverable Roadmap) - Testnet

Tranche #2: Expanded coverage and Fact Sheets

2.1 Close coverage gaps

  • Scope: add every Stellar tokenized asset and issuer identified in Tranche 1 that is not yet covered, plus new Soroban protocols that use tokenized assets

  • How to measure completion: 100% of registry assets have data flowing internally; new issuer and protocol pages built

  • Budget: $15,000

2.2 Standardized tokenized asset metrics

  • Scope: compute market cap, supply, holders, transfer volume, mints and redemptions for every Stellar asset, using the same methodology as other chains

  • How to measure completion: metrics generated and QA'd for all registry assets; methodology documented

  • Budget: $15,000

2.3 Fact Sheets and issuer verification

  • Scope: build Fact Sheets for Stellar assets with meaningful onchain traction (e.g. $1M+ onchain market cap) and reliable price feeds, targeting 35+ assets, and set up an issuer workflow to verify offchain fields (custodian, transfer agent, domicile, legal structure, fees)

  • How to measure completion: 35+ Fact Sheets drafted; verification requests sent to their issuers

  • Budget: $15,000

Tranche #2 total: $45,000

Tranche 3 (Deliverable Roadmap) - Mainnet

Tranche #3: Public launch, maintenance and distribution (mainnet)

3.1 Public launch on Tokenized Assets and RWA pages

  • Scope: all covered Stellar assets live on tokenterminal.com, on the Tokenized Assets page and RWA sector page, with Stellar available in every cross-chain comparison

  • How to measure completion: public pages live and linked in the completion report

  • Budget: $15,000

3.2 Fact Sheets live

  • Scope: publish Fact Sheets for every Stellar tokenized asset with meaningful onchain traction and reliable price feeds (targeting 35+ assets), issuer-verified where the issuer has confirmed the data

  • How to measure completion: 35+ Fact Sheets publicly available for qualifying Stellar assets

  • Budget: $15,000

3.3 Data distribution

  • Scope: Stellar network, ecosystem and tokenized asset data free to explore in the Token Terminal UI and through our free MCP connector, available via API, Sheets plugin and data catalog, and included in the data we deliver to redistribution partners

  • How to measure completion: Stellar tokenized asset data live in the UI, MCP and documented API endpoints

  • Budget: $15,000

3.4 Daily indexing, contract labeling and asset review

  • Scope: daily runs of the Stellar indexing pipeline in BigQuery, a standing process to review new Stellar asset deployments, and labeling of trending Stellar and Soroban contracts so new applications are covered as they gain traction

  • How to measure completion: pipeline runs daily; new Stellar assets reviewed within 2 weeks of deployment; trending contracts labeled on a rolling basis; process documented

  • Budget: $15,000

Tranche #3 total: $60,000
